prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic photorealistic portrait of an approved adult woman seated at a white linen table in a lush greenhouse-style restaurant atrium.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult Scandinavian-inspired woman with long golden-blonde wavy hair, ice-blue eyes, natural skin texture, soft rosy cheeks, subtle makeup, and gentle knowing smile. She wears an elegant white cotton eyelet-lace mini dress with short puff sleeves, fitted bodice and cutout embroidery, seated with arms crossed comfortably on the table.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical portrait at a white linen dining table, subject centered with lush monstera, strelitzia, palms and ferns behind, wooden chairs and restaurant details softly layered, green foliage contrasting the white dress.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour sunlight filtering through glass roof and leaves, soft volumetric rays, natural shadows, gentle bokeh, bright greenhouse restaurant mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm f/1.8, cinematic ARRI-style color, high-detail photorealism, sharp skin and hair strands, realistic eyelet cotton, natural depth, subtle grain.
